project_type: Monorepo. Existing .NET 10 Discord worker in JainaProudmoore/ (Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker). NEW Go send-only voice sidecar to be created in the sibling JainaVoiceSidecar/. Tests in JainaProudmoore.Tests/ (xUnit).
language: C# (.NET 10) for the bot; Go (1.26.0, CGO) for the new sidecar.
build_system: .NET: XML .slnx solution at repo root, global.json pins latest .NET 10 feature band (no previews). Go: new go.mod module. Both images are built from GitHub source directly on Unraid (clone-then-build over SSH deploy key); nothing is pushed to a registry.
build_command: .NET: `dotnet build JainaProudmoore.slnx -c Release -warnaserror`. Go sidecar: `cd JainaVoiceSidecar && go build ./...` (requires CGO + libdave present; authoritative build is the container). Images: `docker build -t jaina-proudmoore JainaProudmoore` and `docker build -t jaina-voice-sidecar JainaVoiceSidecar`.
test_command: .NET: `dotnet test JainaProudmoore.slnx -c Release`. Go: `cd JainaVoiceSidecar && go vet ./...` (and `go test ./...` if any tests are added). Fast local Go check is `go vet ./...` since full build needs CGO+libdave.
verification_instructions: 1) After .NET edits, run `dotnet build JainaProudmoore.slnx -c Release -warnaserror` (must be warning-clean) then `dotnet test JainaProudmoore.slnx -c Release`. 2) After Go edits, run `go vet ./...` in JainaVoiceSidecar; the authoritative build/link (CGO+libdave) is `docker build -t jaina-voice-sidecar JainaVoiceSidecar`. 3) After the sidecar Dockerfile, `docker run --rm jaina-voice-sidecar` must start and (without TOKEN) fail fast with the config error, proving wiring; with TOKEN set it should bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT and log it. 4) Grep to confirm removed apparatus: no `VoicePlayback`/`IAudioClient`/`CreatePCMStream`, no `DAVE-PR-3288`/`local-packages` outside `.agents/`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Go: `go mod tidy` generates/updates go.sum (commit it). No other generated files checked in. .NET: none beyond normal build outputs (bin/obj are gitignored).
environment_constraints: The PLANNING environment has NO `go`, NO `gh`, and no Docker on PATH, so Go build/vet and both docker builds were NOT run during planning — the coder must run them. CGO + libdave dynamic linking means `go build` only fully links where a C toolchain and libdave.so are present (the Docker build stage). The repo is private: Unraid builds clone over an SSH deploy key. Bot reaches sidecar by Docker container name on a shared network; no external ports are published.
contribution_requirements: The .NET bot MUST build warning-clean under `-warnaserror` (TreatWarningsAsErrors). The Go sidecar MUST pass `go build`/`go vet` clean. Pin disgo and godave module versions in go.mod (do NOT float). Keep the godave<->libdave version pairing (document it in the sidecar README). Secrets only via env vars, never source. Only create markdown docs the task asks for.
key_patterns: Verified real disgo/godave API (do NOT invent): DAVE enabled via bot.WithVoiceManagerConfigOpts(voice.WithDaveSessionCreateFunc(golibdave.NewSession)); conn := client.VoiceManager.CreateConn(guildID); conn.Open(ctx, channelID, selfMute bool, selfDeaf bool) -> for send-only self-deaf use conn.Open(ctx, channelID, false, true); conn.SetSpeaking(ctx, voice.SpeakingFlagMicrophone); conn.SetOpusFrameProvider(provider) where provider implements voice.OpusFrameProvider { ProvideOpusFrame() ([]byte, error); Close() }; conn.Close(ctx). Opus encode via github.com/kazzmir/opus-go/opus (opus.NewEncoder(48000,2,opus.ApplicationVoIP), encoder.Encode(pcmInt16, voice.OpusFrameSize, buf)); PCM is 48kHz stereo s16le, a frame = voice.OpusFrameSize*2*2 bytes. ffmpeg transcode exactly as the deleted VoicePlayback: `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel panic -i pipe:0 -ac 2 -f s16le -ar 48000 pipe:1`. Stage-channel caveat (godave #11): conn.DAVE().Ready() stays false on stage/v0-passthrough channels — bound the Ready() wait and return a clear error. .NET: use injected IHttpClientFactory named clients (there is already an "gemini" client in Program.cs); never hand-roll HttpClient. The static-WAV short-circuit in Worker.RunAskJainaAsync must be preserved so re-enabling the commented Gemini block only changes which bytes are sent.
